assumptions.label: Machine class
assumptions.help: The mechanical architecture and payload envelope of the autonomous robot executing the hour of work.

assumptions.label: Deployment duty
assumptions.help: Annual operating hours based on 1-shift (8h), 2-shift (16h), or continuous 3-shift (24/7) facility operations.

assumptions.label: Inference compute
assumptions.help: Onboard neural processing power consumption across embedded Edge NPU, Hybrid Edge+VLA, or Cloud foundation reasoning.

assumptions.label: Human wage comparison
assumptions.help: Prevailing fully-loaded hourly wage of manual human workers replaced or augmented in that jurisdiction.

cyclesPerHour.label: Joint cycles per hour
cyclesPerHour.derivation: Average 2 cycles per second across 6–30 articulated joint degrees of freedom in continuous pick-and-place or manipulation duty.

gridCarbonGPerKWh.label: Grid carbon intensity
gridCarbonGPerKWh.derivation: Weighted global manufacturing grid electricity emissions intensity per kWh consumed.

embodiedSiliconGPerKg.label: Silicon per robot kg
embodiedSiliconGPerKg.derivation: Total packaged semiconductor die mass per kg of finished mechatronic robot across motor MCUs, gate drivers, and edge vision processors.

refinedMetalFactor.label: Refined metal multiplier
refinedMetalFactor.derivation: Ratio of virgin refined engineering materials (sintered NdFeB magnets, electrolytic copper, 100Cr6 bearing steel, structural aluminium) to finished robot mass.

oreToRefinedRatio.label: Ore extraction ratio
oreToRefinedRatio.derivation: Mass of raw mined mineral ore (bastnäsite rare earth deposit, bauxite, iron ore, spodumene) per unit mass of refined engineering material.

maintOverheadFactor.label: Maintenance & spare ratio
maintOverheadFactor.derivation: Annual maintenance, spare actuator modules, seal replacement, and harmonic lubricant replenishment as percentage of initial capex.

chain.label: 1 hour of autonomous work
chain.sub: one continuous hour of physical task execution
chain.why: the terminal unit of the stack

chain.label: Actuator joint cycles
chain.sub: cumulative mechanical oscillation across all degrees of freedom

chain.label: Electrical energy drawn
chain.sub: motor mechanical output, winding I²R resistive losses, and NPU compute

chain.label: Design life consumed
chain.sub: fraction of certified B10 mechanical life expended during this hour

chain.label: Amortised hardware mass
chain.sub: chassis, motors, strain-wave gears, and bearings allocated to this hour

chain.label: Amortised silicon die mass
chain.sub: monocrystalline silicon in motor MCUs, GaN power stages, and edge NPUs

chain.label: Refined engineering alloys
chain.sub: sintered NdFeB magnets, copper wire, and vacuum-melted flexspline steel

chain.label: Lithosphere mined ore
chain.sub: raw bastnäsite, iron ore, and bauxite extracted from the earth

branches.label: Hourly machine amortisation
branches.sub: hardware depreciation plus maintenance overhead per hour

branches.label: Hourly labor cost delta
branches.sub: fully-loaded human worker wage minus hourly robot operating cost

branches.label: Grid carbon emissions
branches.sub: greenhouse gas emissions emitted per autonomous work hour
